name: io.github.sina158/spectre-markets
description: Free, no key: daily gamma levels for NQ, ES, BTC, ETH + session paths. Research/education only.

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description:
List the instruments SPECTRE Markets publishes a levels board for, with the session each
        board is for and a link to the full board.

tools.name: get_levels
tools.description:
The newest published free levels for one instrument (e.g. "NQ", "ES"); its session_date
        says which session, and it may be older than today. The named free levels with their prices,
        the market regime and a short excerpt of the desk read where the board carries them, and how
        many further levels the full board holds. Research/education only.

tools.name: get_paths
tools.description:
Today's ranked possible session paths for one instrument, each with its waypoints and a
        trade idea (entry zone, invalidation, target). Research/education only.
